plugins.name: WorkBuddy
plugins.description: Tencent CodeBuddy (WorkBuddy) OAuth provider for CLIProxyAPI: panel-driven multi-region account login (CN codebuddy.cn or CodeBuddy international codebuddy.ai), dynamic models, chat executor, capability-based daily check-in, legacy WorkBuddy one-shot expert trial (manual), credit lifecycle (disable and keep recoverable accounts, delete only one-shot trials), credits panel with per-service badges and filters, optional credits-aware scheduler.
plugins.author: Sliverkiss

plugins.name: QoderWork
plugins.description: QoderWork CN (qoder.com.cn) provider for CLIProxyAPI: panel OAuth device authorization (copyable/retryable/cancellable, CN only) plus PAT import (coexisting), COSY-signed chat executor, dynamic model list, daily check-in with credit snapshot, token keepalive (deviceToken/jobToken prefix-routed, PAT fallback), accounts panel.
plugins.author: Sliverkiss
